rules.message: summary file is usually agent residue unless explicitly maintained
rules.fix: Delete it or move durable information into an existing maintained document.

rules.message: plan file is usually temporary unless part of project workflow
rules.fix: Delete it or confirm that the repository intentionally maintains plans.

rules.message: implementation narrative is often agent residue
rules.fix: Move necessary operational detail into existing documentation or the change description.

rules.message: notes file needs a clear permanent purpose
rules.fix: Keep only maintained information with an explicit owner and purpose.

rules.message: prefer a maintained changelog or change description
rules.fix: Move durable release history to CHANGELOG.md; otherwise remove the file.
Replace the claim with a verified capability, limitation, or test result.

rules.message: broad polish word; replace it with a concrete fact
rules.fix: Name the specific behavior or remove the adjective.

rules.pattern: \b(tests? pass(?:ed)?|build pass(?:ed|es)?|validated successfully|verified successfully|all checks pass(?:ed)?)\b
rules.message: verification claim needs command or source evidence
rules.fix: Cite the command and result, or say that verification was not run.
State the observable result without promotional framing.
Use a subject-specific heading or remove the unnecessary section.
Use direct prose or bullets whose structure follows the information.

rules.message: generated asset or synthetic content needs provenance
rules.fix: Record the source, generator, date, and relevant usage rights.

rules.pattern: ^\s*(great question|absolutely|you'?re absolutely right|i'?d be happy to)\b
rules.fix: Start with the answer or the verified outcome.

rules.pattern: \b(i'?ll now|i am now|let me now|first,? i'?ll|next,? i'?ll)\b
rules.fix: Report useful progress or the result instead of narrating routine actions.
End after the result unless a recap adds new decision-relevant information.
Stop after the requested result unless a concrete next action is required.
